verdict.rationale: Viam's own CLI documents filter-based bulk operations on data. It can delete data and add or remove tags from all data matching a given filter, and it can export or query data in bulk with SQL/MQL. The evidence does not show bulk operations across machines or other resources, such as running a command or config change on many machines at once. Fleet OTA updates and fragments are mentioned but never described as bulk actions. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operations across machines and resources beyond data, depth on bulk filters and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
